messages:
Alex Chen: quick q — onboarding OryX-7B. config.json points at `s3://redwood-models/oryx/7b/v1/weights.pt` but infra says weights were moved to `gs://internal-weights/oryx/7b/v1/weights/`. which should the model config use for hosted vs private? also tokenizer weirdness: some of the legacy vocab uses `<s>` while our validator expects `bos_token_id`. do we have an alias rule?

Priya Kapoor: short answer: if this is for the public hosted catalog, keep the canonical s3 path. internal/partner-only models can point to GCS but we need gatekeeper rules to allow gs:// URIs.

Mei Tan: tokenizer note — OryX tokenizer is a hybrid byte-level + legacy special tokens. special ids are bos=0, pad=1, eos=2. our schema expects numeric ids under `special_tokens` (e.g. `bos_token_id`). the tokenizer package still uses `<s>`/`</s>` strings in vocab, so we need a translation step during load or make validator accept the string keys and map them.

Samir Patel: CI complaining: linter flags `quant_type: int8` (legacy) — runtime expects `quantization: "int8_dynamic"` or `quantize_profile: true`. can we add aliasing so old configs don't fail builds? also weights path check fails because linter attempts HEAD on s3 path but fails for gs.

config-lint-bot: :warning: config-lint: 3 warnings detected — (1) unexpected field `quant_type` (suggest `quantization`), (2) missing `special_tokens.bos_token_id` (found `specials.bos`), (3) weights_path unreachable (HEAD failed for `s3://redwood-models/oryx/7b/v1/weights.pt`).

Alex Chen: thanks. i'm about to open a tiny PR to update the model entry. what's the preferred minimal config we should put in the repo so CI+onboarding smoke tests pass? post example pls. :eyes:

Mei Tan: minimal example i recommend:
```json
{
  "model_name": "oryx-7b",
  "weights_path": "gs://internal-weights/oryx/7b/v1/weights/",
  "model_type": "causal",
  "tokenizer": {
    "tokenizer_path": "gs://internal-weights/oryx/7b/v1/tokenizer/",
    "special_tokens": {
      "bos_token_id": "0",
      "pad_token_id": "1",
      "eos_token_id": "2"
    }
  },
  "serve": {
    "batching": {"max_batch_size": 32},
    "quantization": "int8_dynamic"
  }
}
```
notes: numeric ids can be strings in the JSON for historical reasons (we coerce), but validator will error if keys are missing.

Priya Kapoor: plan: i'll update the gatekeeper rules to allow `gs://` for internal-only models and add an alias map in the schema validator for `quant_type` -> `quantization`. will do by EOD. @Mei Tan can you add a small migration in the tokenizer loader to map `<s>`/`<bos>`/`bos_token_id` variants?

Mei Tan: yep — i'll add a tiny migration script and unit tests. also will update onboarding smoke test to assert tokenizer loads and that `bos_token_id` is present (or mapped).

Samir Patel: also add a lightweight runtime check in the onboarding workflow: attempt to load first shard of weights with `torch.load(..., map_location='cpu')` (timeout 20s) and fail fast if unreachable. that should catch s3 vs gs mismatches before full rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy check queued for `onboarding-smoke/orxy-7b` — status: queued.

Alex Chen: perfect, thanks all. i'll update the PR with the suggested minimal config and the smoke test, then ping for review. :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: heads-up — i'll post the gatekeeper change in #eng-infra once it's merged so other teams know about gs allowance.

Mei Tan: added TODO in the tokenizer repo and a draft test. ping me on the PR for quick review.

Samir Patel: great, thanks. i'll watch the CI changes.

Alex Chen: merging plan: once gatekeeper + validator aliases + tokenizer migration are in, i'll flip the model entry to `gs://` and re-run onboarding smoke. expected timeline: 24–48h.

config-lint-bot: :white_check_mark: note: after alias rule added, `quant_type` will be accepted as an alias but linter will emit deprecation warning for 3 releases.

Alex Chen: ok cool. leaving this thread open until smoke passes. thanks everyone!
